passages.heading: Debt note
passages.text: 8. Debt 2030 Notes On October 29, 2021, the Company issued $ 1.0 billion aggregate principal amount of its 3.875 % Senior Notes due 2030 (the “2030 Notes”). The 2030 Notes mature on May 1, 2030. The 2030 Notes bear interest at a rate of 3.875 % per annum. Interest on the 2030 Notes is payable semi-annually in arrears on May 1 and November 1 of each year, commencing on May 1, 2022.

passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition, results of operations, and cash flows should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements, and related notes appearing under “Consolidated Financial Statements and Supplementary Data” in Item 8 of this filing. This discussion and analysis and other parts of this Annual Report on Form 10-K contain forward-looking statements, such as those relating to our plans, objectives, expectations, intentions, and beliefs, that involve risks, uncertainties, and assumptions. Our actual results could differ materially from these forward-looking statements as a result of many factors, including those discussed in the section titled “Risk Factors,” “Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements,” and “Special Note Regarding Operating Metrics” included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Our historical results are not necessarily indicative of the results that may be expected for any periods in the future. Unless the context otherwise requires, all references in this report to “Roblox,” the “Company,” “we,” “our,” “us,” or similar terms refer to Roblox Corporation and its subsidiaries. This section of our Annual Report on Form 10-K discusses our financial condition as of and results of operations for the fiscal years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, as well as year-to-year comparisons between fiscal years 2025 and 2024. A discussion of our financial condition as of and results of operations for the fiscal year ended 2023 and year-to-year comparisons between fiscal years 2024 and 2023 that is not included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K can be found in “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024. Because certain reported amounts are rounded, the sum of the respective components reported for these amounts may not equal the total amount reported and the percentages presented may not add to their respective totals. Overview People from around the world come to Roblox every day to connect. Together they create, play, work, learn, and connect with each other in experiences built by our global community of creators. Our Platform is powered by user-generated content and draws inspiration from gaming, entertainment, social media, and even toys. Our immersive gaming and creation Platform consists of the Roblox Client, the Roblox Studio, and the Roblox Cloud (collectively, the “Roblox Platform” or the “Platform”). Roblox Client is the free application that allows users to explore immersive experiences. Roblox Studio is the free toolset that allows creators to build, publish, and operate immersive experiences and other content accessed with the Roblox Client. Roblox Cloud includes the services and infrastructure that power our Platform. We are continually innovating our Platform by investing in high fidelity avatars, more realistic experiences, artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools, and other connection features. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: A description of the risks and uncertainties associated with our business is set forth below. You should carefully consider the risks described below, as well as the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including our consolidated financial statements and “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations.” The occurrence of any of the events or developments described below could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and growth prospects. In such an event, the market price of our Class A common stock could decline, and you may lose all or part of your investment. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently believe are not material may also impair our business, financial condition, results of operations, and growth prospects. Risk Factors Summary Below is a summary of the principal factors that make an investment in our Class A common stock speculative or risky: • We have a history of net losses and we may not be able to achieve or maintain profitability in the future. • Our business is affected by seasonal demands, and our financial condition and results of operations will fluctuate from quarter to quarter, which makes our financial results difficult to predict and may not fully reflect our underlying performance. • We are subject to laws and regulations worldwide that are constantly evolving, which could increase our costs or adversely affect our business, including preventing our ability to operate our Platform in certain jurisdictions. • We have experienced rapid growth at times, in part due to the virality of certain experiences on our Platform, and our growth rates may not be indicative of our future growth or the growth of our market. • We depend on effectively operating with third-party operating systems, hardware, and networks that may make changes affecting our operating costs, as well as our ability to maintain our Platform, which would hurt our business. • The success of our business model is contingent upon maintaining a strong reputation and brand, including our ability to provide a safe online environment for our users, many of whom are children, to experience and if we are not able to provide such an environment, our business will suffer dramatically. • We are subject to numerous legal proceedings that are costly and time-consuming to defend and could harm our business, financial condition, or results of operations. • If we fail to retain users or add new users, or if our users decrease their level of engagement with our Platform, our revenue, bookings, and operating results will be harmed. • We depend on our creators to create digital content that our users find compelling, and if we fail to properly incentivize our creators to develop and monetize content, our business will suffer. • If we are unable to further monetize our Platform and user base, our business will suffer. • The loss of one or more of our key personnel, or our failure to credit_strengths.text: Roblox's operating cash flow has scaled rapidly, more than doubling over the prior year and now covering capital expenditures several times over. This internally generated liquidity funds platform investment without reliance on external borrowings, a notable strength for a company still reporting operating losses.

The balance sheet carries a net cash position, with unrestricted cash and short-term investments exceeding total debt. Liquidity is further supported by a substantial current asset base, though the current ratio sits modestly below parity and below the sector median, reflecting heavy deferred revenue and accrued creator payables.

key_risks.text: The company has a history of net losses and may not achieve or maintain profitability, as disclosed in its risk factors. Operating losses persist despite strong revenue growth, and the business is exposed to seasonal demand fluctuations, evolving global regulation, and dependence on third-party platforms, all of which could pressure future cash generation.

Debt structure centers on senior notes maturing in a single year, with the vast majority of principal due at that maturity. Refinancing risk is concentrated rather than staggered, and the notes carry a fixed coupon payable semi-annually, creating a discrete future liquidity event that warrants monitoring against cash flow trends.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is deeply negative on an operating income basis, far below the sector median, because the company remains loss-making at the operating line. However, cash flow coverage of debt is strong, with free cash flow exceeding total debt, indicating that cash generation, not accounting earnings, underpins current debt servicing capacity.

The debt maturity profile is heavily weighted to a single future year, with only modest amortization before then. Given the net cash position and robust free cash flow, the company appears well placed to address this maturity, but the concentration means refinancing conditions at that time will materially influence future interest costs.

overall_credit_view.text: Roblox presents a paradoxical credit profile: strong and growing cash generation, a net cash balance sheet, and no near-term maturities, offset by persistent operating losses and an indicative financial risk profile that is not meaningful due to negative EBITDA. The absence of conventional leverage metrics limits ratio-based comparison with sector peers.

Our forward-looking view is that credit quality hinges on sustaining free cash flow growth to comfortably cover the concentrated maturity and fixed coupon. Continued operating losses and regulatory or platform risks could erode this cushion. We would monitor cash flow trends and any shift toward shareholder distributions or debt-funded investments.

credit_strengths.text: Roblox 的營運現金流迅速擴大，較上一年度增長超過一倍，現時足以覆蓋資本開支數倍。此內部產生的流動性為平台投資提供資金，而無需依賴外部借款，對一家仍錄得營運虧損的公司而言是一項顯著優勢。
資產負債表持有淨現金狀況，未受限現金及短期投資超過總債務。流動性進一步得到龐大流動資產基礎的支持，儘管流動比率略低於一，且低於行業中位數，反映大量遞延收入及應計創作者應付款項。

key_risks.text: 該公司歷來錄得淨虧損，且可能無法實現或維持盈利，如其風險因素所披露。儘管收入增長強勁，營運虧損仍然持續，且業務面臨季節性需求波動、不斷演變的全球監管，以及對第三方平台的依賴，這些均可能對未來現金產生構成壓力。
債務結構集中於單一年份到期的高級票據，絕大部分本金於該到期日到期。再融資風險集中而非分散，且該等票據附有每半年支付的固定票息，形成一個需對照現金流趨勢加以監察的離散未來流動性事件。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 以營運收入為基礎計算的利息覆蓋率為深度負值，遠低於行業中位數，因該公司於營運層面仍錄得虧損。然而，債務的現金流覆蓋強勁，自由現金流超過總債務，表明支撐當前債務償付能力的是現金產生，而非會計盈利。
債務到期狀況嚴重集中於單一未來年份，在此之前僅有少量攤銷。鑑於淨現金狀況及強勁的自由現金流，該公司似乎處於有利位置應對該到期，但集中性意味著屆時的再融資條件將對未來利息成本產生重大影響。

overall_credit_view.text: Roblox 呈現一個矛盾的信用狀況：強勁且增長的現金產生、淨現金資產負債表，以及並無近期到期債務，但被持續的營運虧損及因 EBITDA 為負而並不具意義的指示性財務風險狀況所抵銷。缺乏傳統槓桿指標限制了與行業同業的比率比較。
我們的前瞻性觀點是，信用質素取決於能否維持自由現金流增長，以從容覆蓋集中的到期債務及固定票息。持續的營運虧損以及監管或平台風險可能侵蝕此緩衝。我們將監察現金流趨勢，以及任何轉向股東分派或債務融資投資的變化。
